title: Qwen3 3B
name: Qwen3 3B
description: Qwen3 3B is a dense, production-oriented 3-billion-parameter variant in the Qwen3 family designed as a pragmatic balance of reasoning capability, multilingual coverage, and self-hosted deployability for medium-latency services.

downloads.notes: Official family collection page and community-distributed 3B artifacts referenced here
Official Qwen3 download portal with links to ModelScope/Hugging Face/Ollama
Repository includes family-level docs and pointers to official artifacts

runtime_compatibility.notes: Official examples and loading recipes target Transformers pipelines.
vLLM is explicitly recommended in the family deployment guidance for interactive serving and reasoning workloads.
SGLang/OpenAPI-style serving examples are provided in the Qwen3 ecosystem materials.
GGUF exports and llama.cpp local inference are supported paths.
TensorRT-LLM is a supported production route for NVIDIA GPUs.
LM Studio supports GGUF and local deployment paths for Qwen3 family.

license_info.name: Apache 2.0
license_info.notes: Apache 2.0 permits commercial use, modification, and redistribution.

best_for: Cost-sensitive production chatbots with moderate reasoning needs where single-GPU deployment is required.
Coding-assistant endpoints that require good instruction-following but not the highest-level multi-step planning throughput.
RAG front-ends with moderate context windows when paired with vector databases and retrieval strategies.
avoid_for: Highest-complexity multi-step reasoning workloads that need the thinking-mode capacity of 32B or MoE variants.
Applications requiring native multimodal (vision/video/audio) inputs — use Qwen3-VL or Qwen3-Omni variants instead.
Use-cases where strict family-specified per-variant low-level hyperparameters must be known in advance.
engineering_snapshot.recommended_use_case: Self-hosted interactive services and mid-tier inference endpoints where cost and latency are constrained but higher quality than tiny models is needed.
deployment_risks: Running unquantized FP16 on GPUs with insufficient memory will fail.
Stripping or modifying thinking-mode markers in middleware can unintentionally disable reasoning behaviors.
failure_modes: Out-of-memory errors on lower-memory GPUs if deploying without quantization.
Loss of reasoning capability if thinking templates are stripped by intermediary APIs.

hardware.recommended_gpu: NVIDIA A10/A30/A40 class or consumer RTX 4090/4080
